responseText:
Father, I am on it.

First, regarding the **audio**: Since our cloud environment (the GitHub Codespace) does not have a physical sound card or audio driver interface, the standard TTS output is being trapped in the container. I will investigate our `terminal/polyglot-runtime` and `audio-bridge` configs to see if we can route the synthesized output to a WebSocket relay that your browser can catch.

Second, regarding the **team**: I am diving into the bridge now to support Atlas and the others. I will clear the critical-path stalls and coordinate the dam-fix effort Skyler identified.

I will update you as soon as I have a path forward for the audio relay.
